question: Which of the following autobiographies is written by I.K. Gujral, one of the former Prime Ministers of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Matters of Discretion**__.

• **Matters of Discretion** is an **autobiography of I.K. Gujral**, who served as the **Prime Minister of India from April 1997 to March 1998.**
